title: The Yard Runs
text: The yard is running: a depot chewing at the rock, a bay with its doors open. The empty berth stays lit. Thalassa hangs low over the horizon, banded and enormous, and somewhere round it are Engram's moons. Maren and Pip are on the routes.

choices.label: Head home
choices.reply: The lander lifts. The yard keeps working without us.

choices.label: Stay a while
choices.reply: We stay. The depot keeps chewing at Talus.

notes: onDone of yard. The Act 2 "Expedition complete" card: Return to Touchdown travels home; Stay keeps playing here (the Command Core lists every route).
